def comps(A):
    Hh=len(A); Ww=len(A[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(Hh):
        for j in range(Ww):
            if A[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                c=A[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<Hh and 0<=y<Ww and A[x][y]==c and (x,y) not in seen:
                                seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
                out.append((c,tuple(cells)))
    return out

def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    shapes=comps(I)
    byc={}
    for c,s in shapes: byc.setdefault(c,[]).append(s)
    blocks=[]
    for c,ss in byc.items():
        top=min(ss,key=len); bot=max(ss,key=len)
        br=max(r for r,_ in bot)
        th=max(r for r,_ in top)-min(r for r,_ in top)+1
        tr=(br-th-1, min(c for _,c in top))   # top row and its leftmost col? need translation: keep orientation
        blocks.append({'c':c,'top':top,'bot':bot,'tr':tr})
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b:min(min(c for r,c in b['top']),min(c for r,c in b['bot'])))
    # horizontal: block width = span of both shapes after placing bot at cols starting where?
    # place bottom shapes first left-to-right; top shape placed directly above (same leftmost col as its bottom counterpart?), aligned so that top shape sits within same block.
    # d1: color6 top n3 @ cols? output top cells cols0-1, bottom n4 cols0-1 -> top left = bot left - 0? bottom left col0. top at cols0-1 same. 
    # color1: bottom n7 cols0-3?? output rows8-9: 6 6 0 1 1 1 1 -> cols3-6; top 4-cell rows5-6 cols3-5. So top left=3=bottom left=3. yes top left = bottom left!
    # d2: color4: bottom n6 cols5-7, top n4 cols5-6 -> left 5=5 ✓. color3: bottom n8 cols0-3, top n3 cols0-2 ✓.
    # block width = max col of bottom - min col of bottom +1
    def bw(b): return max(c for r,c in b['bot'])-min(c for r,c in b['bot'])+1
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b:bw(b))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    left=0
    for b in blocks:
        # bottom: rows H-h..H-1 with h = height of bot
        hr=max(r for r,_ in b['bot'])-min(r for r,_ in b['bot'])+1
        for r,c in b['bot']: out[H-hr+r][left+c]=b['c']
        tr0=b['tr'][0]
        for r,c in b['top']: out[tr0+r-min(r for r,_ in b['top'])+ (b['tr'][0]- (max(r for r,_ in b['bot']))+hr-1)][left+c]=b['c']
        left+=bw(b)+1
    return out

def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    shapes=comps(I)
    byc={}
    for c,s in shapes: byc.setdefault(c,[]).append(s)
    blocks=[]
    for c,ss in byc.items():
        top=min(ss,key=len); bot=max(ss,key=len)
        blocks.append({'c':c,'top':top,'bot':bot})
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b:min(min(c for r,c in b['top']), min(c for r,c in b['bot'])))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    pos=0
    for b in blocks:
        bot=b['bot']; top=b['top']
        bc=min(c for r,c in bot)
        br=max(r for r,_ in bot); hh=br-min(r for r,_ in bot)+1
        bw=max(c for r,c in bot)-bc+1
        tht=max(r for r,_ in top)-min(r for r,_ in top)+1
        # Assembly: top sits directly above bottom shape, shifted up so their overlap column matches,
        # gap of exactly one empty row between them (gap row exists iff heights sum > available? no—always)
        # From demos: top bottom row = H-hh-1-tht+tht... use data-driven: top placed so its BOTTOM rests 1 row above bottom shape TOP row.
        tbottom = (H-hh) - 1 - 1   # bottom row of top = (row above bottom-top-row) - 1? d3: need verify later
        tc0=min(c for _,c in top)
        for r,c in bot: out[H-hh+r-br][pos+(c-bc)]=b['c']
        for r,c in top: out[tbottom-r+tbottom-min(r for r,_ in top)][pos+(c-tc0)]=b['c']
        pos+=bw+1
    return out

def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    shapes=comps(I)
    byc={}
    for c,s in shapes: byc.setdefault(c,[]).append(s)
    blocks=[]
    for c,ss in byc.items():
        top=min(ss,key=lambda s:min(r for r,_ in s))
        bot=[s for s in ss if s!=top][0]
        blocks.append({'c':c,'top':top,'bot':bot})
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b:min(c for _,c in list(b['top'])+list(b['bot'])))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    pos=0
    for b in blocks:
        tt=min(r for r,_ in b['top']); t0=min(c for _,c in b['top'])
        tb=min(r for r,_ in b['bot']); b0=min(c for _,c in b['bot'])
        hh=max(r for r,_ in b['bot'])-tb+1
        tht=max(r for r,_ in b['top'])-tt+1
        A = H - hh - tht - 1
        for r,c in b['top']: out[A+r-tt][pos+(c-t0)]=b['c']   # top normalized to block col
        for r,c in b['bot']: out[H-hh+r-tb][pos+(c-b0)]=b['c']
        pos+=max(max(c for _,c in b['top']),max(c for _,c in b['bot']))-b0+1+1
    return out

def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    cs_=comps(I)
    byc={}
    for c,s in cs_: byc.setdefault(c,[]).append(s)
    blocks=[]
    for c,ss in byc.items():
        if len(ss)!=2: continue
        def key(s): return (min(r for r,_ in s), max(r for r,_ in s))
        a,b=sorted(ss,key=key)
        top,bot=a,b if a[0]<b[0] else b,a
        blocks.append((c,top,bot))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b:min(min(c for _,c in s) for s in (b[1],b[2])))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    pos=0
    for c,t,b_ in blocks:
        tt=min(r for r,_ in t); t0=min(c for _,c in t)
        bt=min(r for r,_ in b_); b0=min(c for _,c in b_)
        hh=H-bt; # bottom occupies rows H-hh .. H-1
        tb=H-hh; A=tb-2; A-=tt; top_top=A
        bw=max(max(c for _,c in t)+ (pos - pos),0) # placeholder
        w = max(pos+max(c-t0 for _,c in t), pos+max(c-b0 for _,c in b_)) - pos +1
        for r,c_ in t: out[A+r-tt][pos+c_-t0]=c
        for r,c_ in b_: out[tb+r-bt][pos+c_-b0]=c
        pos=w+1
    return out

    blocks=[]

        blocks.append((c,top,bot))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda bc:min(min(c2 for _,c2 in s) for s in (bc[1],bc[2])))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    pos=0
    for c,t,b_ in blocks:

        bt=min(r for r,_ in b_); b0=min(c for _,c in b_)

def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    cs_=comps(I)
    byc={}
    for cc,s in cs_:
        byc.setdefault(cc,[]).append(s)
    blocks=[]
    for cc,ss in byc.items():
        if len(ss)!=2: continue
        top,bot=sorted(ss,key=lambda s:min(r for r,_ in s))
        blocks.append((cc,top,bot))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda bc:min(min(c2 for _,c2 in bc[1]),min(c2 for _,c2 in bc[2])))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    pos=0
    for cc,t,b_ in blocks:
        tt=min(r for r,_ in t); t0=min(c2 for _,c2 in t)
        bt=min(r for r,_ in b_); b0=min(c2 for _,c2 in b_)
        tht=max(r for r,_ in t)-tt+1
        hh=max(r for r,_ in b_)-bt+1
        tb = H-hh
        A  = tb-tht-1
        for r,x in t: out[A+r-tt][pos+x-t0]=cc
        for r,x in b_: out[tb+r-bt][pos+x-b0]=cc
        w = max(max(x-t0 for _,x in t), max(x-b0 for _,x in b_))-pos+1
        pos = pos + w + 1
    return out

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    R=solve(G2[name+' input']);O=G2[name+' output']
    print(name,R==O)
    if R!=O:
        for r in R: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
        print('--')
        for r in O: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
